call_points.text: Advances growth target maintained at 19-21% and deposit growth target kept at 23-25% for FY27.
Cost-to-income ratio reduced to 64.3% in Q2 from 67.0% in Q1; target is to reach 57% over time.
Full-year credit cost expected under 2%, with H2 credit cost expected lower than H1's 0.92%.
Affordable housing grew 28.2% YoY, MSME grew 20.6% YoY, and vehicle loans surged 76% YoY.
LODGED ₹68 Cr of claims under guarantee program; remaining ₹251 Cr to be lodged next year in Q3.
Secured book to grow 25-30% and unsecured 10-12% in FY27; Micro LAP seen at 12-15%.
Cost-to-income to improve; management cites March 2024's 57% as the level it remembers.
MSME is the one segment management is watchful on for Middle East war spillover; no impact visible yet.
Universal bank application to be resubmitted now that audited results are out; no benefit built into FY27 guidance.
Cost of funds reduced to 7.46% in Q4 FY26 compared to 8.03% in Q4 FY25.

operating_notes.text: Bank transferred ₹392.26 Cr principal of NPAs to ARCs for ₹189.81 Cr consideration in Q4FY26, against net book value of ₹177.92 Cr.
Security receipts outstanding were ₹1,433.09 Cr as at March 31, 2026.
Bank purchased ₹91.13 Cr of loans not in default during Q4FY26 and transferred ₹29.18 Cr of SMA loans to ARCs.
Secured book reached 72.6% of total advances as of March 31, 2026.
Disbursements were ₹7,894 Cr in Q4 FY26, up 16% over Q3 FY26.
Asset GLP reached ₹36,289 Cr as of March 31, 2026, with secured book at 73%.
Slippages in Q4 FY26 declined by 24% vs Q3 FY26, bringing credit cost down to 0.47%.
SMA book at 3.66% in March 2026, below March 2024's 3.99%; Q4 slippages of ₹334 Cr were the lowest in eight quarters.
Unsecured book 77.1% under guarantee programme; net NPA of ₹184 Cr, of which ₹151 Cr is under the guarantee programme.
Used car business launched October 2025, running at ₹25 Cr disbursals a month across 15 cities, to expand to 35 cities by September.
Promoter Jana Holdings Limited agreed to sell 5,160,903 shares (about 4.9% of paid-up capital) to TVS Motor Company Limited for ₹193.31 Cr.
Warrant issue price ₹464.82 is above the 10-day VWAP of ₹464.80 and the 90-day VWAP of ₹403.02 as of the 12 May 2026 relevant date.
Unsecured loan book stands at ₹673 Cr gross NPA with ₹377 Cr provisions, leaving ₹296 Cr covered under guarantee program.
Top seven state concentration of advances stands at 67%, with top three states at 37%.
MFI customer overlap remains low, with 97% of customers having <= 2 MFIs compared to 93% industry average.

timeline.summary: Jana Small Finance Bank reported Q4FY26 PAT of ₹139.8 Cr (Q3FY26: ₹9.7 Cr) and FY26 PAT of ₹326.4 Cr; with gross NPA at 2.46% and RoA at 0.79%.
Jana Small Finance Bank reported Q4FY26 PAT of ₹140 Cr and issued FY27 guidance of 19-21% GLP growth.
Jana Small Finance Bank reported Q4FY26 PAT of ₹140 Cr with GNPA improving to 2.3% and highest-ever quarterly disbursements of ₹7,894 Cr.
NarayanaMurthi Raja, Lakshmi R. N informed BSE and NSE of the earnings conference call recording link for Q4FY26 and FY26 on 29 April 2026.
Jana Small Finance Bank's Q4FY26 call guided FY27 PAT growth of 80%+, GLP growth of 19-21% and deposits of 23-25%, saying the microfinance stress is behind it.
On 18 May 2026, Jana Small Finance Bank approved a ₹728.51 Cr preferential warrant issue and a ₹500 Cr Tier II bond raise, calling an EGM for June 11, 2026.
On 18 May 2026, promoter Jana Holdings Limited agreed to sell 5,160,903 shares, about 4.9% of Jana Small Finance Bank, to TVS Motor Company Limited for ₹193.31 Cr under an SPA.

On 20 May 2026, Jana Small Finance Bank issued the notice for its 11 June 2026 EGM seeking approval of a ₹728.51 Cr preferential warrant issue at ₹464.82 per warrant to six investors and up to ₹500 Cr of non-convertible debt.
On 23 October 2026, Jana Small Finance Bank reported Q2FY27 standalone net profit of ₹170.36 Cr with Gross NPA improving to 2.34%.
Jana Small Finance Bank Limited provided a link to the audio recording of its earnings conference call for the quarter ended 30th September 2026.
Jana Small Finance Bank held its Q2FY27 earnings call, doubling FY27 PAT growth guidance to 100% YoY following a strong H1 performance.
